Terms of use

For full program details visit starbucks.com/rewards/terms.

Starbucks® Rewards benefits are available at participating Starbucks stores. Not all stores have the ability to honor Rewards at this time. Visit the Starbucks Store Locator and search for locations honoring "Redeem Rewards".

Earn Rate

  • Green members earn 1 Star per $1 spent at participating stores.
  • Gold members earn 1.2 Stars per $1 spent at participating stores.
  • Reserve members earn 1.7 Stars per $1 spent at participating stores.
  • Stars are not earned on Starbucks Cards, reloads, alcohol, tax or tips.

Redeeming Rewards

At participating stores. Some restrictions apply. Free food and beverage Rewards may be redeemed at participating stores and exclude alcoholic beverages and multi-serve items.

*Digital Starbucks Card Reload Bonus Stars

Digitally reload $30+ to receive 10 Bonus Stars or $50+ to receive 25 Bonus Stars.

Star Expiration

Green member Stars (including partial Stars) earned toward free food and drink Rewards expire 6 months after they are earned. Green members may extend their Star expiration date by one month by completing one of the following in the calendar month prior to the original Star expiration date: 1) make a qualifying purchase at a participating store. Excludes purchases of Starbucks Cards, alcohol and delivery services; 2) Redeem a Reward at a participating store; or 3) Digitally reload $30 or more to your Starbucks Card through the app or web.

Stars don’t expire as long as you maintain Gold or Reserve status. See Starbucks Rewards® Terms and Conditions for details.

Birthday Reward

  • Green members: Redeemable on birthday only.
  • Gold members: Redeemable for 7 days.
  • Reserve members: Redeemable for 30 days.
  • Free birthday drink must be standard menu size.
  • Excludes alcohol and multi-serve items.

Mod Monday

Redeemable at participating stores. Members receive one free customization each month.

Personal Cup Benefit

Bring a clean reusable cup to participating stores and earn Bonus Stars while reducing waste.
